brief:
Israeli occupation forces set up a military checkpoint in the center of Hebron city, according to Shehab Wire. The deployment occurred amid ongoing security operations in the West Bank territory. Details regarding the checkpoint's specific location within the city center, its operational scope, and stated objectives were not immediately available.

The establishment of the checkpoint adds to the security infrastructure Israeli forces maintain throughout Hebron, a city that has experienced repeated military operations and settler-related tensions. Checkpoints in Palestinian population centers typically restrict movement and require residents to undergo security screening at designated crossings.
